name: Connection and runtime identity
outcome: get_status advertises coordinated release, separate fingerprints, host and capabilities.
recommendation: Keep current route; distinguish release, interface and protocol versions.

name: Open-document discovery and targeting
outcome: list_documents returns live document IDs, paths, family names and dirty state; IDs replace font indices.
recommendation: Retain per-connection IDs. Frontmost selection is a separate unresolved context gap.

name: Glyph inventory and metadata
outcome: Known names expose five fields. No glyph enumeration, layerCount or kerning-group fields; get_glyph_details also formerly supplied script/productionName.
recommendation: Keep bounded projections, but explicitly decide bounded glyph discovery and missing scalar reads. No full-font response required.

name: Master metrics and axes
outcome: Native ID/name enumeration retained. Weight/width axis values, italicAngle, ascender, capHeight, descender and xHeight are absent from reads.
recommendation: Decide additive requested fields in existing master reads. P04 verified identification, not all v1 master properties.

name: Instances
outcome: No instance entity or list; native coding can inspect instances, but no focused equivalent inspection route is shipped.
recommendation: Choose bounded instance reads or an explicit native-only Beta 1 policy; do not claim variable-font inspection parity.

name: Layer inventory, geometry and components
outcome: Known exact layer IDs expose metrics/bounds/hash; selected nodes have details. No per-glyph layer enumeration, associatedMasterId, full paths/shape indices, anchor/path/component counts or component transforms/alignment reads.
recommendation: Prioritize layer discovery and bounded one-layer structural evidence. A hash and a visual overlay are not a geometry response.

name: Font View selection and current context
outcome: Selection resolves currentTab.activeLayer only. Font View multi-selection, selectedFontMaster, explicit frontmost document, UPM and font/version counts are not returned.
recommendation: Prioritize a compact native context projection through read_entities; keep detailed nodes restricted to one Edit View layer.

name: Selected Edit View nodes
outcome: selection.context.v1 supplies exact active glyph/layer, counts and optional bounded nodes, default 64/max 256. Rich v1 repeated metadata and master correspondence are not returned.
recommendation: Keep the explicit counts/details contract. Additional cross-master selection mapping stays outside this capability.

name: Stored kerning and group discovery
outcome: Exact named/group-key values, absent versus zero and LTR/RTL/vertical retained. No pair-table enumeration or glyph-group membership reads. Collision reports reveal keys for prepared pairs only.
recommendation: Decide a bounded discovery route; do not run an edit-preparation job merely to discover kerning groups.

name: Width and exact sidebearing edits
outcome: width_delta is additive across all stored layers, including backups/special layers. No single-master filter or arbitrary absolute width/LSB/RSB setter. Spacing suggestions are not equivalent absolute setters.
recommendation: Document a focused native metrics recipe or explicitly defer that workflow. Never expand a requested master scope to all stored layers.

name: Spacing review and application
outcome: External spacing retains reference/area policy, class-aware selection, fractions and native alignment protections. v1 rules/defaults/guards/debug parameter surface is intentionally reduced.
recommendation: Keep the tested lean algorithm and state narrower options; do not promise arbitrary v1 rules compatibility.

name: Spacing guides and persistent spacing parameters
outcome: No guide-writing job or dedicated persistent-parameter write; options belong to each prepared job. Native guides remain available.
recommendation: State that job options do not migrate persistent v1 spacing rules or reproduce managed guides. Native route needs task-specific verification.

name: Collision kerning review and repair
outcome: Explicit LTR pair corrections retained with native effective resolution and exact exceptions. No automatic v1 relevant-pair discovery, kerning proof-tab option or complete option parity.
recommendation: Keep explicit measured-pair scope and report sampling limits. Automatic discovery is not supplied by the retained collision job.

name: Arbitrary kerning pair/group edits
outcome: No public arbitrary set/remove pair operation. Collision jobs only generate measured positive corrections; raw bridge patch mechanics are not public tools.
recommendation: Provide a short qualified native recipe if ordinary manual pair editing is a Beta 1 promise. Do not claim collision repair covers it.

name: Kerning proof tabs
outcome: Native tabs can be opened via UI/scripts; the dedicated bounded proof generator is not in the seven tools.
recommendation: Document proof-text/tab creation as native work; no equivalent v2 generator was qualified in this audit.

name: Start-node alignment
outcome: start_nodes retains tested correspondence on one selected contour, preserving reference phase. Refuses malformed, ambiguous, open or mismatched contours.
recommendation: Keep qualified native replay and exact history. This does not implement the earlier inspect/normalize/reorder compatibility plan.

name: Italic first pass
outcome: slant supplies native mechanical shear and optional straight-stem preservation. Full balanced/cursivy policy, curve correction, source-to-target master copying and arbitrary special-layer repair are not ported.
recommendation: Keep the mechanical-first-pass claim. No complete v1 optical-italic parity claim.

name: Master italic angle and stem editing
outcome: No master metadata/stem setter. Slant uses a requested angle and does not set the master italicAngle property.
recommendation: Explicit native Font Info/script step when requested. Outline slant and master metadata are separate tasks.

name: Node coordinates and path replacement
outcome: General outline changes use authored native scripts/UI. RV01/RV02 qualified selected move/add/remove/extrema/split tasks, not arbitrary path replacement.
recommendation: Keep the native precision recipe and per-task preservation tests; do not imply scripts acquire MCP job discard.

name: Components, anchors and corner hints
outcome: No corresponding public edit job. Native APIs/UI remain available, but current realistic tests do not qualify all three v1 edit outcomes.
recommendation: Treat these as native-only and qualify concrete tasks; populated-hint preservation remains unverified in RV02.

name: Glyph creation, deletion, copying and properties
outcome: The seven tools do not expose general glyph CRUD; native scripting/development is the documented route.
recommendation: Keep explicit target and data-preservation checks. Retaining a generic script route is not proof of every former tool behavior.

name: Custom parameters
outcome: No custom-parameter entity or setter; font/master/instance native APIs are available through coding.
recommendation: Document explicit native-only status; do not conflate these with per-job options.

name: OpenType and stylistic sets
outcome: RV02 supplies focused feature source review/edit/compile/export/shaping guidance. v1 one-call stylistic-set substitution listing and group deep links are not recreated.
recommendation: Keep corrected OpenType routing; add a concise stylistic-set inspection/proof recipe if that convenience is retained. No new feature MCP tool needed.

name: Unicode/PUA audit and allocation
outcome: Unicode assignment tools and v1 icon-font skill are not in the lean payload. Generic native scripting does not preserve v1 collision/range/previous-map allocation policy automatically.
recommendation: Explicitly defer icon/Unicode allocation for Beta 1 or port the focused native guidance and qualify it. Do not claim drawing/native Unicode UI replaces the allocator.

name: LitSquare metadata and semantic roles
outcome: Metadata Inspector and LitSquare UI/tools were explicitly removed from the lean bridge; stored native metadata is not intentionally deleted.
recommendation: Keep independent project tooling/native scripting separate. Release notes must say authoring/inspection integration is absent.

name: IconGrid fixed-centering integration
outcome: Standalone Icon Grid remains independent; the MCP read/set/reset policy is not ported or advertised.
recommendation: Do not describe the independent Reporter as a substitute for the removed agent controls. No second Icon Grid implementation.

name: Tunni analysis and balance
outcome: Custom Tunni algorithms/candidates were explicitly excluded from the lean benefit queue.
recommendation: Use existing native/manual methods where appropriate; no equivalent algorithm or automated outcome claim.

name: Adaptive curve and cross-master diagnostics
outcome: Curve Inspector supplies a bounded visual comb; no public adaptive event/continuity report or cross-master quality report equivalent to v1.
recommendation: Explicitly defer numerical diagnostic reports or specify a bounded external report recipe. A comb is not analytical parity.

name: Curvature display
outcome: Independent Curve Inspector/native UI retains qualified display behavior. No MCP overlay-toggle/state tool; capability registration alone is not control.
recommendation: Keep companion/UI distinction and P13 evidence; do not invent public companion calls.

name: Collinear smooth-node repair
outcome: Custom smoothness repair and candidate flow are explicitly outside the queue; native UI/script actions remain separate.
recommendation: Keep native scope; no equivalent multi-target guarded smoothness repair is claimed.

name: Compensated scaling
outcome: General compensated scaling/candidate generation explicitly excluded.
recommendation: Do not port the custom engine for parity alone; state absence in migration notes.

name: Candidate sessions and history
outcome: Supported edits use jobs/reports/apply/discard and native per-glyph Undo. Independent Reference Inspector compares references, not historical proposal sessions.
recommendation: Keep lean native history; unsupported v1 candidate families do not become supported merely because the job lifecycle exists.

name: Annotations and managed annotation groups
outcome: No dedicated annotation/group reads or writes. Native annotations can be authored through UI/scripts; managed-group identity/cleanup policy is not supplied.
recommendation: Explicit native-only Beta 1 policy; consider focused proofing guidance, not a new annotation subsystem.

name: Designspace/UFO export
outcome: Dedicated static/variable Designspace/UFO exporter and build-script generation are absent. RV02 TTF export evidence is a different deliverable.
recommendation: Record explicit exporter deferral or qualify an existing external conversion route; do not claim TTF export replaces Designspace/UFO.

name: Save and persistence
outcome: Native Save is acceptance, with task authorization. No MCP save command; jobs require a saved clean source.
recommendation: Keep the deliberate boundary. Dirty/pathless reads are supported; dirty/pathless job edits are not.

name: Live Python execution
outcome: General Python execution is deliberately absent from MCP. Workspace scripts/native CLI or authorized in-app routes are used; saved CLI copies do not see unsaved live state.
recommendation: Keep current coding loop and scoped verification. No extra execution tool is justified by RV02.

name: Documentation search and retrieval
outcome: Bundled offline corpus plus local docs.py search/get replaces MCP docs tools; bounded results and provenance retained.
recommendation: Keep focused offline retrieval and pinned source separation.

name: Document change overview
outcome: Per-job status/report and bounded activity replace the tracked MCP mutation overview; there is no equivalent global audit/change-history view.
recommendation: Keep per-job evidence and native reference comparison; do not rebuild an audit/history model.

name: Embedded feedback panels and target links
outcome: No legacy MCP App feedback panel or embedded-plan endpoints. Agent reports and native companions/UI replace parts of review; clickable per-glyph/style-set navigation is not equivalent.
recommendation: Document the UI/access change and decide whether lightweight proof navigation needs a focused recipe. No embedded feedback framework required.
